item: Row 286: the last applied daily file's date beside the extract date on the OSM surfaces
summary: One reading, country_data_date, gives the extract date, the replication timestamp of the last daily file applied in an unbroken sequence (never the apply time) and a state: none, dated, or date not read. The picker lane cell, the map OSM line, the completeness heads, the object and place cards, the view legend, geography and trends read it. No file applied: unchanged. Timestamp not recorded: 'daily updates applied, data date not read', nothing stands in. 8 strings x12, no 'current as of'. No new egress.
